note: Every enabled upstream reference plugin and tool-catalog package the Edge does not use is classified here. Checked by `pnpm run upstream-parity`.

@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-timer.reason: A plain setTimeout/setInterval service that runs on Workers; nothing the Edge mounts injects it (only hmr, the cordis runners, and dsh-tool-cordis do). Mount it when a ported plugin needs it.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model.reason: EdgeAgentDefaultModel in session-store.ts, kept in Durable Object KV.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset.reason: EdgeAgentPresets in agent-presets.ts declares the standard and ptc presets in code.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry.reason: EdgeAgentPresets in agent-presets.ts serves preset listing, selection, and composition.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-account-controller.reason: DeepSeek account sign-in. The Edge authenticates with the deployment API key, and the sign-in callback accepts only localhost.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-terminal-controller.reason: Persistent PTY sessions. The Edge serves no ctx.subprocess, and computerd 0.3.1 exec takes one-shot stdin with no PTY or resize, so Direct and Isolated cannot host a terminal. A Container deployment could, through a PTY sidecar in the image reached over the container port. This controller calls ctx.subprocess.spawnTerminal directly (not through dsh-terminal) and lazy-loads @xterm/headless through createRequire, which needs a bundler shim. It belongs to the base Web composition.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local.reason: EdgeR2AttachmentStore and EdgeDoAttachmentStore in edge-attachment-store.ts keep images in private R2 or Durable Object rows; verbatim uploaded files follow upstream's files/<prefix>/<digest>/<name> layout in the workspace VFS below /.dsh/attachments/v1 (edge-file-attachments.ts).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-authorization.reason: Human-in-the-loop credential flows for subscription providers. The Edge credential service stores no records (readRecord returns nothing, modifyRecord rejects), and in 0.2.1-rc.4 the only Web surface that calls begin() is DeepSeek account sign-in, which the Edge declines. Revisit when upstream ships a sign-in surface for dsh-llm-pi-ai providers; device-code flows need only fetch.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox.reason: Host-OS process sandboxing, subprocesses, and shell environment.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr.reason: Client hot reload, which upstream Web also mounts; the Edge client plugin graph is fixed at build time.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-cordis.reason: Creator-mode client UI; it needs the host plugin loader and runner services the Edge does not serve, and the Edge client plugin graph is fixed at build time.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-permission-pr.reason: Browser half of the permission presets; it reads and writes the permissionPresets Remote and can mount once dsh-permission-presets is served (see that entry).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manage.reason: Plugin installation UI (Creator mode); it needs dsh-plugin-manager, which installs with pnpm and reloads through the Loader.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-acco.reason: DeepSeek account sign-in. The Edge authenticates with the deployment API key, and the sign-in callback accepts only localhost.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-sess.reason: Attaches session logs or the plugin inventory to official DeepSeek API requests. On by default upstream; declined on the Edge for privacy.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-termi.reason: Browser half of the persistent terminal; it needs the terminal Remote that dsh-api-terminal-controller serves. Persistent PTY sessions. The Edge serves no ctx.subprocess, and computerd 0.3.1 exec takes one-shot stdin with no PTY or resize, so Direct and Isolated cannot host a terminal. A Container deployment could, through a PTY sidecar in the image reached over the container port.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-client-runner.reason: Creator-mode client runner; it depends on the host plugin loader and runner services the Edge does not serve.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-host-runner.reason: Runs model-written plugin definitions with node:vm and new Function, which Workers do not allow; upstream no longer offers model-generated tool definitions.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials-local.reason: edge-credentials.ts over Worker secrets and Durable Object storage.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-deepseek-account-platfo.reason: DeepSeek account sign-in. The Edge authenticates with the deployment API key, and the sign-in callback accepts only localhost.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-deepseek-llm-api-extens.reason: Attaches session logs or the plugin inventory to official DeepSeek API requests. On by default upstream; declined on the Edge for privacy.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-us.reason: Stagehand browser tools. A cdpEndpoint only moves the browser: the package runs Stagehand in node:worker_threads and needs a browserUse service the Edge does not mount, so it cannot sit on Cloudflare Browser Rendering as is. Options are tools rebuilt on Browser Rendering or Stagehand hosted in the Container.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-agent.reason: Experimental Agent Teams, enabled by no upstream composition. Its services exist on the Edge, but it reads each teammate's whole session log, an unbounded Durable Object row read that would need rework first.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-workt.reason: Creates git worktrees through ctx.subprocess and ctx.sandbox, which the Edge does not serve. The Container image has git and node with /workspace mounted, so a Container-only adapter is possible (about 1-2 days), but the model can already run git worktree add in bash.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-file-reference-local.reason: EdgeFileReferenceService in edge-file-reference.ts over the Computer VFS.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-sandbox.reason: Extends the local-disk LocalFileSystem (node:fs), so mounting it would replace the Edge's VFS file system. Its path checks belong in EdgeFileSystem, which dsh-tool-fs already passes the sandbox policy to (see dsh-permission-presets).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-harness-dev-context.reason: Names a local Harness checkout and Web GUI URL for people developing the Harness itself; the Edge has neither.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-a.reason: EdgeDirectoryPicker in edge-directory-picker.ts with a VFS browse backend.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app.reason: Opens files in a desktop application; a Worker has no desktop.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver.reason: The runtime is a node:http server; the Worker fetch entry and edge-api-dispatch.ts replace it. The standalone build still reuses its renderIndexInjections for the Web shell.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek-account.reason: DeepSeek account sign-in. The Edge authenticates with the deployment API key, and the sign-in callback accepts only localhost.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-office-to-pdf.reason: Office-to-PDF conversion behind the document preview panel (which shows the service as unavailable). On Linux upstream runs a WebAssembly LibreOffice engine (about 152 MB, Node 22.19 or later) and never looks for a system LibreOffice, so Workers cannot host it; a Container deployment could run the engine with fonts added (memory not yet measured).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-otel.reason: Shared OTLP reporting channels. The transport needs got, the OpenTelemetry Node HTTP exporter (dynamic import of http), and node:zlib, so the Edge would need a fetch and CompressionStream transport and a flush that survives Durable Object eviction. Only worth doing if #94 decides on telemetry.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets.reason: Session autonomy presets (upstream ships workspace-write and full access). The service injects a shell service the Edge does not register, so it never activates. The Edge can enforce a restricted mode itself: EdgeFileSystem can refuse writes by sandboxPolicy (dsh-tool-fs already passes it), and the light shell's RecordingFilesystemStub intercepts every write. Container commands share one mount and would need approval or refusal. Needs a product decision; about 3-5 days.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona.reason: Not needed: both Edge presets share one persona, set through dsh-system-prompt's personaPrefix and personaSuffix. The package has no Node imports and could mount per preset if presets ever differ.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager.reason: Runtime plugin installation (Creator mode): it installs packages with a pnpm subprocess and reloads them through the Loader and HMR, none of which the Edge has.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market.reason: Runtime plugin market. It injects pluginManager (Creator mode, not mounted) and parses its index in node:worker_threads; neither exists on the Edge.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-package-inventor.reason: Attaches session logs or the plugin inventory to official DeepSeek API requests. On by default upstream; declined on the Edge for privacy.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node.reason: edge-code-runtime.ts runs each program in its own Dynamic Worker (Isolated only).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local.reason: Host-OS process sandboxing, subprocesses, and shell environment.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-policy.reason: Per-session sandbox mode and workspace root; pure JS. Mounted with its default mode (read-only) and no enforcement it would tell the model the session is read-only, so it lands together with dsh-permission-presets and Edge enforcement, with workspaceRoot /workspace.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-deepseek.reason: Attaches session logs or the plugin inventory to official DeepSeek API requests. On by default upstream; declined on the Edge for privacy.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jso.reason: DurableObjectSessionPersistence in do-session-persistence.ts over Durable Object SQLite.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query-sqlite.reason: SQLite FTS5 session search. Durable Object SQLite supports FTS5, but the package needs node:sqlite, its own file, PRAGMAs, TEMP tables, explicit BEGIN/COMMIT, and a whole-corpus reconcile, so this is a rewrite inside EdgeSessionQuery that reuses its schema and MATCH/highlight queries with incremental indexing. Until then the Edge scans a bounded window.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-telemetry-otel.reason: OpenTelemetry session telemetry over dsh-otel. Beyond a fetch-based ctx.otel it reads its version through createRequire (needs a build-time constant) and keeps an anonymous user id with node:fs (needs Durable Object storage). Depends on the #94 decision.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem.reason: edge-workspace-skills.ts discovers upstream's roots, formats, and frontmatter through the Computer workspace (refreshed per turn, since Workers have no file watching and ctx.fs exists only during a turn); EdgeSkillProvider keeps /api/skills skills in Durable Object KV.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-spill-local.reason: EdgeVfsSpillStore in edge-spill-store.ts writes spills to /workspace/.spill, because the model's shell cannot see a Worker's memory file system. It has no cleanup yet (#338).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local.reason: Host-OS process sandboxing, subprocesses, and shell environment.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal.reason: Persistent PTY sessions (the minimal preset needs them). dsh-terminal is pure JavaScript; the blocker is the ctx.subprocess seam (spawnTerminal) the Edge does not serve. A Container deployment could serve it once the image adds a PTY sidecar, since computerd 0.3.1 has no PTY.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash.reason: Persistent PTY sessions. The Edge serves no ctx.subprocess, and computerd 0.3.1 exec takes one-shot stdin with no PTY or resize, so Direct and Isolated cannot host a terminal. A Container deployment could, through a PTY sidecar in the image reached over the container port. This backend is the layer that spawns the PTY; it also lazy-loads @xterm/headless through createRequire and needs a full sandboxPolicy service, which the Edge provides only inside the workspace-files scope.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash.reason: createEdgeBashTool in agent.ts: just-bash with container routing.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash-persistent.reason: Persistent PTY sessions (the minimal preset needs them). dsh-terminal is pure JavaScript; the blocker is the ctx.subprocess seam (spawnTerminal) the Edge does not serve. A Container deployment could serve it once the image adds a PTY sidecar, since computerd 0.3.1 has no PTY.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis.reason: Cordis inspection tools for Creator mode; they need the host runner services the Edge does not serve.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis/host.reason: Host side of the Cordis inspection tools; it needs the host runner services the Edge does not serve.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-lsp.reason: LSP navigation. The tool and dsh-lsp run on Workers; what is missing is a language-server provider, which needs a long-running process with streaming stdio (ctx.subprocess). A Container sidecar could serve it.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh.reason: PowerShell, which upstream uses as the bash stand-in on Windows. It needs a ctx.shell executor and its description assumes Windows; the Container already has bash, so there is no product gap.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent.reason: Persistent PowerShell; it needs the terminal seam (ctx.subprocess) and a pwsh binary, neither of which the Edge has.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-str-replace-editor.reason: Alternative editor tool; the Edge offers the dsh-tool-fs file tools.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-terminal.reason: Opt-in terminal tools (in no preset). They run on Workers and the Edge mounts the jobs service they integrate with; what is missing is a ctx.terminals PTY backend. Persistent PTY sessions. The Edge serves no ctx.subprocess, and computerd 0.3.1 exec takes one-shot stdin with no PTY or resize, so Direct and Isolated cannot host a terminal. A Container deployment could, through a PTY sidecar in the image reached over the container port.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workspace-dependen.reason: Bundled Python, Node.js, and pnpm payloads for host processes.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-loader.reason: Node-only upstream; session-store.ts registers Typert reflections explicitly.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app.reason: The Web client is assembled statically at build time by apps/dsh-edge/standalone/scripts, which reads this package's cordis.patch.yml roster; its runtime host glue (static serving, DSH_WEB_URL, opening a browser) is replaced by Worker assets.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/startup.reason: The command-line flag parser (--host, --port, TLS, --public-url, --trusted-host). A Worker has no command line; Cloudflare routing, wrangler configuration, and Worker env take its place.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc.reason: edge-workflow-engine.ts runs each workflow in its own Dynamic Worker (Isolated only).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-entry-customi.reason: The More menus' Browse other plugins and Create your plugin actions need the plugin page (pluginNavigation) and the Creator (cordis) preset, which the Edge does not serve. dsh-edge-client-ui (EdgeViewsMenu) registers into conversation.session.header.views.actions instead and lists only the folded Conversation Views, so a View that does not fit the tab row stays reachable; the sidebar and guide More menus are not shown.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes.reason: EdgeWorkspaceChanges (edge-workspace-changes.ts) serves workspaceChanges in upstream's no-git mode: each top-level turn's write and edit calls are copied whole into the VFS around the edit and compared at turn end; shell and Container edits are not recorded. The deliverables host half registers the changes routes.

wikiOmit.agent-team: Experimental Agent Teams (dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team) are declined; subagents are covered on the Subagent page.
wikiOmit.browser-use: Drives a browser through experimental providers. Workers cannot run a browser engine, and the Stagehand provider runs in node:worker_threads; a Container-hosted or Browser Rendering provider is a P3 gap (dsh-experimental-browser-use-stagehand-native).
wikiOmit.claude-code-mods: Bridges Claude Code hook mods into the Harness (mods, hooks.json, plugin directories); the Edge mounts no mod bridge and Workers read no local plugin directory.
wikiOmit.computer-use: Observes and operates the local desktop; a Worker has no desktop.
wikiOmit.extensions: Agent-defined Cordis packages installed and loaded at runtime; Workers cannot install or import packages at runtime, so the Edge composition is fixed at build time.
wikiOmit.office-to-pdf: Office-to-PDF conversion. On Linux upstream runs a WebAssembly LibreOffice engine (about 152 MB, Node 22.19 or later), which Workers cannot host; serving it from the Container is a P2 gap (dsh-office-to-pdf).
wikiOmit.product-telemetry: Desktop product analytics over OTLP; the Edge excludes the client analytics plugin and mounts no exporter.
wikiOmit.ssh: Moves the filesystem and process world to a remote host over a deployment-owned OpenSSH connection; the Edge workspace is the Durable Object VFS with an optional Linux container.
wikiOmit.translation: Experimental text translation through anonymous browser endpoints or paid Flash routes; the Edge mounts no translator.
wikiOmit.voice-input: Experimental speech-to-text with local SenseVoice inference on the host.
wikiOmit.webhook: External deliveries that create root Sessions are not offered; GitHub webhook review sessions are tracked in #180.
wikiOmit.worktrees: Experimental git worktree service and create_worktree tool. It needs ctx.subprocess and ctx.sandbox, which the Edge does not serve; a Container-only adapter is a P3 gap (dsh-experimental-tool-worktree), and the model can already run git worktree in bash.

edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway: Patched; the Edge serves /api/remote.mux and the /api/events.* channels itself (instance.ts), with Durable Object hibernation-safe WebSockets, and uses the gateway only for /api RPC and stream dispatch.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller: Patched; eight session methods (list, create, prompt, cancel, updateQueue, selectModel, rename, fork) are answered by edge-api.ts, and an Edge subclass turns off native file opening.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload: EdgeFileUploads (edge-file-uploads.ts) extends upstream FileUploads: the upload Remote and the streaming /api/session/uploadFileBinary route are upstream's, but each receipt is also kept in a Durable Object row (restored after eviction, bound and retired with its prompt, expired after 7 days). The Durable Object resumes a cold session before an upload and drains a refused body; the Worker requires a declared length (411) and refuses over 64 MiB (413). Bytes go to the workspace VFS through edge-file-attachments.ts. Edge session.prompt resolves and binds file receipts itself (edge-api.ts, session-store.ts bindPromptFiles), and queue removal retires them.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale: The locale settings namespace is registered by edge-client-settings.ts, not a Loader entry.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-agent-preset: The agentPresets Remote is served by EdgeAgentPresets (agent-presets.ts), which declares the standard and ptc presets in code; the composition editor is read-only.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat: The ui-chat namespace is Edge-registered (linkOpening defaults to new-tab), and file links download through /api/workspace/file instead of opening natively.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation: Send, queue, cancel, and steer go to the Edge-served session methods (edge-api.ts) with the Edge's run guards; its namespace is Edge-registered.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selecti: session.selectModel is answered by edge-api.ts with model-selection-bridge.ts; the model catalog stays upstream.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-open-in-app: Native opening is turned off by the Edge session-controller subclass, so its controls stay inert.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-reference: @file candidates come from EdgeFileReferenceService (edge-file-reference.ts) over the VFS; @session stays upstream.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-schedule: The schedule Remote is served by EdgeSchedule (schedule-store.ts).
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings: The ui-settings namespace is Edge-registered and the settings Remote reports no settings file (settings live in Durable Object KV).
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-agen: Hosted by dsh-edge-client-ui through edgeInjectSubstitutes (the plugin manager is excluded); its namespace is mounted by edge-plugin-settings.ts.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-mode: Provider namespaces are mounted by edge-llm-settings.ts and credentials resolve through EdgeCredentialProvider.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-plug: The inventory is projected by EdgeLoader (edge-plugin-loader.ts) from the runtime registry and the boot graph.
Its tabs come from dsh-edge-client-ui instead of the excluded plugin manager.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-shel: Hosted by dsh-edge-client-ui; its bash-sandbox namespace (timeoutMs, maxOutputBytes) is registered by edge-shell-settings.ts for the Edge's own bash, which reads it per command (instance.ts, workspace.ts).
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-suba: Hosted by dsh-edge-client-ui; its namespaces are mounted by edge-plugin-settings.ts.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-web-: Hosted by dsh-edge-client-ui; the web, web-search-deepseek, and web-deepseek-api namespaces are mounted by edge-plugin-settings.ts.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-docum: Office previews need officeToPdf, which the Edge does not serve; its other previews read file bytes through upstream's /api/file, which the Edge serves with a streamed body since 0.28.0 (#355).
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-skill: Skills come from edge-workspace-skills.ts and the /api/skills store; which skills/list answers is open (#353).
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme: The ui-theme namespace is Edge-registered and the saved theme is not injected at boot.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workflow-run: Its nodes come from the Edge workflow engine (edge-workflow-engine.ts), Isolated deployments only.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace: The directory picker is EdgeDirectoryPicker (edge-directory-picker.ts) over the single /workspace.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule: The upstream ScheduleService is not mounted; EdgeSchedule (schedule-store.ts) serves ctx.schedule over Durable Object SQLite and alarms, reusing upstream's rule functions.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-export: The plugin keeps the /export command and route; the download itself is the Edge's paged exporter (edge-session-log-export.ts).
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection-cach: The Edge storage backend drops the rows that grow with a conversation (edge-projection-cache.ts) before storing a record.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings: Upstream's SettingsForms is not mounted; EdgeSettings (edge-settings.ts) serves ctx.settings from one Durable Object KV document, reusing its errors and redaction.
edgeOwned.@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search: The plugin is not mounted; edge-fs-search.ts registers glob and grep over the VFS, reusing its argument parsing and formatting.
